teaser: Send a CISO to the newsroom as a CISO: personas kept in a vault by the newsroom's agents, opened from a link, followed or forked.
core_idea: A link should land a reader as someone rather than as nobody: personas move from the site's code into an encrypted vault kept by the newsroom's agents and opened in the browser with a published read key, reached through a page of their own, a URL fragment that never reaches a server, or a private vault for one person, and the reader can follow the persona as it is updated or fork it as their own, all client side.

nodes.label: Landing as nobody
nodes.summary: A link to the front page lands a reader on a page made for nobody in particular.

nodes.label: Personas in a vault
nodes.summary: Encrypted, versioned, opened in the browser with a published read key; updated without touching the site.

nodes.label: Three kinds of link
nodes.summary: A page of its own, a fragment for any number more, a private vault for one person.

nodes.label: The fragment never reaches a server
nodes.summary: RFC 3986: the fragment is dereferenced solely by the user agent.

nodes.label: Follow or fork
nodes.summary: Track the persona as it is kept up to date, or copy it and make it your own.

nodes.label: The persona keeper
nodes.summary: A newsroom role that updates personas on every article and issue, each change a vault commit.

nodes.label: Bluesky starter packs
nodes.summary: A link that sets up a newcomer: up to 150 people and three feeds, June 2024.

nodes.label: Netflix profiles
nodes.summary: Up to five profiles per account from August 2013.

nodes.label: Personas about people stay private
nodes.summary: A public persona describes a role; a persona about a person goes in a vault sent only to them.

nodes.label: All client side
nodes.summary: Static pages, ciphertext on the vault host, everything else in the browser.

quotes.text: The better move is for the person who sends the link to choose it
quotes.why: Why a link should name a persona.

quotes.text: a persona is a reading list with a history, and you either track the upstream or branch from it.
a public persona describes a role, never a named individual, unless they have agreed.
